paragraphs: Isi ben Akavya, Pesachim 113b. Chananya ben Akavya, Eruvin 86b.[^1]

notes.text: קיג:. and פו:. give Pesachim 113b and Eruvin 86b under the colon convention with terminal stops, without independent named-edition verification. Isi and Chananya remain separate attestations; shared patronymics do not establish a single father. No personal title is supplied for any of these names.
